rationale: Identity: in the held 4 FR 2749 page, the text immediately before '[No. 8187]' is the Executive Order amending Subdivision VI of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules, signed June 29, 1939. Its title matches the catalog. Its sole command adds paragraph 6 ('During the period beginning July 1, 1939 and ending June 30, 1940, all positions in the Federal Bureau of Investigation, except fingerprint classifiers'). That insertion is self-executing and complete on issue, the inserted text is limited to a period that ended June 30, 1940, and the order contains no other command. None of the three searches has a hit. Provisional no is supported.
